spell.core.armageddon.description.advanc:
{Advanced Armageddon}

Rains fire down upon the battlefield, damaging all units for (Spell Power x 40 + 60) hit points.
spell.core.armageddon.description.basic:
{Basic Armageddon}

Rains fire down upon the battlefield, damaging all units for (Spell Power x 40 + 30) hit points.
spell.core.armageddon.description.expert:
{Expert Armageddon}

Rains fire down upon the battlefield, damaging all units for (Spell Power x 40 + 120) hit points.
spell.core.armageddon.description.none:
{Armageddon}

Rains fire down upon the battlefield, damaging all units for (Spell Power x 40 + 30) hit points.
spell.core.earthElemental.description.ad:
{Advanced Summon Earth Elemental}

Allows you to summon (Spell Power x 2.5) earth elementals on the random position of your edge of the battlefield. Elementals will serve you until the end of the battle.
spell.core.earthElemental.description.ba:
{Basic Summon Earth Elemental}

Allows you to summon (Spell Power x 2) earth elementals on the random position of your edge of the battlefield. Elementals will serve you until the end of the battle.
spell.core.earthElemental.description.ex:
{Expert Summon Earth Elemental}

Allows you to summon (Spell Power x 3) earth elementals on the random position of your edge of the battlefield. Elementals will serve you until the end of the battle.
spell.core.earthElemental.description.no:
{Summon Earth Elemental}

Allows you to summon (Spell Power x 2) earth elementals on the random position of your edge of the battlefield. Elementals will serve you until the end of the battle.

spell.core.fireWall.description.advanced:
{Advanced Fire Wall}

Places a 3-hex wildfire on the battlefield at a point specified by the caster for 2 rounds.  Any units passing through the wall take (Spell Power x 15 + 20) damage.
spell.core.fireWall.description.basic:
{Basic Fire Wall}

Places a 2-hex wildfire on the battlefield at a point specified by the caster for 2 rounds.  Any units passing through the wall take (Spell Power x 15 + 10) damage.
spell.core.fireWall.description.expert:
{Expert Fire Wall}

Places a 3-hex wildfire on the battlefield at a point specified by the caster for 2 rounds.  Any units passing through the wall take (Spell Power x 15 + 50) damage.
spell.core.fireWall.description.none:
{Fire Wall}

Places a 2-hex wildfire on the battlefield at a point specified by the caster for 2 rounds. Any units passing through the wall take (Spell Power x 15 + 10) damage.
spell.core.forgetfulness.description.adv:
{Advanced Forgetfulness}

Mind spell. Causes the selected enemy ranged unit to forget to use its ranged attack in combat. Half of unit also forget to use hand-to-hand attack. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.
spell.core.forgetfulness.description.exp:
{Expert Forgetfulness}

Mind spell. Causes all enemy ranged troops to forget to use their ranged attack in combat. Half of each unit also forget to use hand-to-hand attack. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.
spell.core.protectAir.description.advanc:

spell.core.slow.description.advanced:
{Advanced Slow}

Reduces the speed of the selected enemy unit by the formula (old speed x 0.5 + 1). Removes Haste effect. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.
spell.core.slow.description.basic:
{Basic Slow}

Reduces the speed of the selected enemy unit by the formula (old speed x 0.75). Removes Haste effect. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.

Reduces the speed of all enemy units by the formula (old speed x 0.5 + 1). Removes Haste effect. Spell is active for number of rounds equal to hero Spell Power.
